evidence.title: Disk Cleanup - C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Temp
evidence.content: The best way to delete everything in the Temp folder is to boot into safe mode, then open file explorer window and go to %temp%. I've written a Cleanup batch file, that does clean out many of the Temp folders in Windows. I just ran my Batch file yesterday, before I did a C: drive backup, and when I ran it again a few minutes ago, it found and removed over 46k of junk files....created in just one day. **Del /F /S /Q C:\\*.tmp** will find and delete every file in your PC, with a name that ends in .tmp   Here is a script that will delete files and folders within Temp folder. WCTxxxx.tmp files in C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Temp

tavily.title: Disk Cleanup - C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Temp
tavily.content: The best way to delete everything in the Temp folder is to boot into safe mode, then open file explorer window and go to %temp%. I've written a Cleanup batch file, that does clean out many of the Temp folders in Windows. I just ran my Batch file yesterday, before I did a C: drive backup, and when I ran it again a few minutes ago, it found and removed over 46k of junk files....created in just one day. **Del /F /S /Q C:\\*.tmp** will find and delete every file in your PC, with a name that ends in .tmp   Here is a script that will delete files and folders within Temp folder. WCTxxxx.tmp files in C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Temp
